palette.notes: Code palette_size 3 is not the art (the still is probably a dark or end frame); not used. Each scene has its own scheme: amber sunset, cyan interior, deep blue night with red neon, teal city rain.

lighting: Strong mood lighting per scene: low sun backlighting, sunlit windows with cool shade, neon signs and lit windows as the only light at night.
silhouette: Environments, not characters: houses, trees, shop fronts and skylines; a black cat silhouette sits in two scenes as a small reward to spot.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 100 ms (p75 166.7), 3.0 drawings/s, on 3s: mostly still images with slow ambient loops (rain, flicker) and hard cuts.

texture: Dense painterly pixel art at full canvas (pixel_scale 1 on the copy), clean pixels; foliage clusters, light rays and reflections do the detail.
camera: Static wides, landscape 4:3 in a vertical post; slideshow of scenes cut to music, one split frame of twin city panels.

acting.enters: No acting: a cat or a seated figure is already in place when the scene cuts in.
acting.acts: Figures sit still; only the world moves (rain, lights).
acting.exits: Hard cut to the next scene.
acting.depth: Tiny figures and the cat are placed small in large environments so the place carries the mood.

techniques: one dominant colour per scene (amber, cyan, blue-red, teal)
light sources inside the scene (neon, windows) as focal points
small creature hidden in a big set as a spot-it reward
slideshow cut to music, scene changes on the beat
dense foliage clusters framing the edges
feel: one-colour mood per scene + tiny cat in a big lit set + cuts on the beat = nostalgic lofi slideshow
for_fred: Use Fred as the tiny spot-it creature: hold a wide establishing scene for a second with him small in a window or corner doing one thing, then cut close. Give each scene one dominant colour.
